title: Add Milestone and Issue Linking Flags
description: Add --milestone flag to goal creation to link existing milestone instead of creating new one. Add --issue flag to ticket creation to link existing issue instead of creating new one.
summary: Added --milestone flag to goal open command and --issue flag to ticket open command. These flags allow linking to existing GitHub milestones/issues instead of creating new ones. Updated structs, CLI parsing, MCP tools, GraphQL schema, and tests.
